reference.source: lengthM (512 ft 3 in overall) and maxSpeedMps (19.3 kn, converted with 1 kn = 0.514444 m/s) from the U.S. Navy's 'Evolution of Aircraft Carriers' (primary service publication), read 2026-09-26. beamM (65 ft 2 in waterline), deckWidthM (108 ft 1 in maximum), and flightDeck 478 ft x 80 ft from the English Wikipedia article 'Casablanca-class escort carrier', read 2026-09-26. deckHeightM is an ESTIMATE; trapZone and paddles reuse Plan 8 gameplay choices scaled to the shorter deck; turnRateRadPerS (1.5 deg/s) is an ESTIMATE. hullHp is a gameplay choice between the merchant's 240 and Essex's 600. ARMAMENT (Track M, M1, read 2026-10-08): Gambier Bay's fit of one 5"/38 on the stern, eight twin Bofors 40 mm and 20 single Oerlikon 20 mm (English Wikipedia 'USS Gambier Bay' infobox, as tools/models/blender/casablanca-cve.py cites; the class article gives 1 x 5"/38, 8 twin 40 mm and 20 x 20 mm as the 'ultimate' fit). The 5" and 40 mm are built at that script's ESTIMATED positions; the 20 mm stand statically along the galleries, four fire positions of five.
